# ADR-3207: AWS iam: Long-term IAM user access key for workload 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Static keys leak and rarely rotate.

## Decision

Workloads SHALL NOT use a long-term IAM user access key for workload 7 (AWS-iam-7).

## Consequences

Prefer roles and temporary credentials.
